Expulsion from the Core and Colonies to a network of reserves established in the Rim is the logical course of action.|Janus Greejatus|{{StoryCite|story=Kernels and Husks|book=From a Certain Point of View: Return of the Jedi}}}} '''Janus Greejatus''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] official who served on the [[Imperial Ruling Council|Ruling Council]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Prior to the [[Imperial Era|Age of the Empire]], he [[Emissary|represented]] the [[Office of the Chancellor|office]] of [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] at the homecoming of [[Poggle the Lesser]] on the [[planet]] [[Geonosis]]. Following the end of the [[Clone Wars]] and the [[Proclamation of the New Order|birth]] of the [[New Order]], Greejatus continued to serve Palpatine, now the [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] of [[the galaxy]]. He perished when the Death Star was destroyed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|My lords, ISB fears that political dissenters may be planning to launch a propaganda operation similar to the wartime Shadowfeeds but directed, of course, against the Empire.''"
"''That's a bit far-fetched, Colonel, even for ISB.|[[Wullf Yularen]] and Janus Greejatus|}} During the [[Clone Wars]], a pan-[[The galaxy|galactic]] civil war between the [[Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Janus Greejatus served as a [[Senior Advisor]] of [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]].''[[Rise of the Separatists]]'' During the homecoming of [[Poggle the Lesser]], Greejatus attended the ceremony—alongside several other dignitaries, including [[Ars Dangor]], [[Sly Moore]], [[Sate Pestage]] and [[Lieutenant Commander]] [[Orson Callan Krennic|Orson Krennic]]—which took place in the [[Petranaki Arena]], on the [[planet]] [[Geonosis]]. [[File:EmperorsArrival-SWHC10.png|thumb|left|225px|Greejatus as an adviser to the Emperor.]] Greejatus would go on to serve Palpatine as one of his closest [[Advisor|advisers]] after the latter's [[Proclamation of the New Order|rise]] as [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Greejatus walked around like a [[Deity|god]] on his [[homeworld]].''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]'' In [[14 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']] to [[14 BBY]]. he was serving in the ranks of the [[Imperial Ruling Council]], a governing body which consisted of the [[Emperor's adviser]]s who oversaw the [[Standard day|daily]] management of the Empire. In the [[Standard year|years]] leading up to the [[Galactic Civil War]], Greejatus and his colleague, [[Sim Aloo]] were tasked with collecting [[Sith]] [[Sith artifact|artifacts]] from across [[the galaxy]] for their master. The Emperor heard rumors of an [[Enchantress' book|book]] of [[Dark side of the Force|dark power]] guarded by [[Corellian hound|monsters]] in a [[forest]] on the [[planet]] [[Ushruu]] and expressed interest in having it for himself. Greejatus hired a team of [[Trandoshan]]s to retrieve the [[book]] from the Ushruu. However, the Trandoshans were eaten by the [[queen snarler]], and Greejatus' plan failed.''[[The Mighty Chewbacca in the Forest of Fear!]]'' In the year [[4 ABY]], Greejatus accompanied the Emperor aboard the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]]. He and the five other advisers on board all [[Death|perished]] when the [[battle station]] was destroyed during the [[Battle of Endor]]. ==Personality and traits== Janus Greejatus was a gaunt [[human]] [[Gender|male]] of short stature, with [[Color|brown]] [[hair]] and light skin. He had a puffy face with dark, sunken [[eye]]s. Like the other members of the Imperial Ruling Council, he wore baggy [[robe]]s of garish color and floppy [[hat]]s, which were not unlike the [[Clothing|garb]] of the [[Naboo (people)|Naboo]] [[noble]]men. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|On ''Jedi'', one of the most exciting things from a design point of view was the advisers who surround the Emperor. I spent a lot of time trying to figure out what they might look like because I thought it was important that through them you might understand what the Emperor's world is like. Coming from a Catholic background, I sort of made a joke, and that's why they look like bishops. So they wear red, and they have elaborate headgear. This was a challenge because it wasn't in the script, and you see them only briefly in the movie.|[[Nilo Rodis-Jamero]], on the designs of Janus Greejatus and the other Imperial advisors|''[[Star Wars: The Annotated Screenplays]]''}} Janus Greejatus first appeared as an unnamed Imperial advisor in the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], the final installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[original trilogy]]. The character, who was portrayed by an uncredited background extra, went unnamed until the name "[[Janus Greejatus/Legends|Janus Greejatus]]" was used in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] pack ''[[Death Star II Limited]]''.{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Janus Greejatus}} The name was then [[canon]]ized with its inclusion in [[James Luceno]]'s [[2014]] novel [[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']]. Greejatus' costume was designed by [[Nilo Rodis-Jamero]]. Rodis-Jamero felt that the look of the Imperial advisors was one of the most exciting designs from ''Return of the Jedi'' and thought their design would need to convey an idea about the kind of world that the Emperor lived in. Rodis-Jamero based the look on that of [[Wikipedia:Catholic Church|Catholic]] [[Wikipedia:Bishop|bishops]], with red coloring and ornate headpieces. The [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]] entry of Janus Greejatus doesn't specify his death, simply stating that while one could assume that he died when the second Death Star was blown up, his ultimate fate was unknown. However, the [[Star Wars Helmet Collection 10|tenth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Helmet Collection]]'' stated that Greejatus did die aboard the second Death Star. ==Appearances== *''[[Catalyst: A Rogue One Novel]]'' {{Ab|Catalyst: A Rogue One Novel (audiobook)}} *[[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']] {{Ab|Tarkin (audiobook)}} {{1stID|Janus Greejatus}} *''[[The Mighty Chewbacca in the Forest of Fear!]]'' {{Ab|The Mighty Chewbacca in the Forest of Fear!
